# Terms of Service

_Version 1.0.0 · Last updated 2026-10-02_

These Terms of Service ("Terms") are a contract between you and Calecute Technologies LLC, a {{STATE_OF_FORMATION}} limited liability company with its registered address at {{ADDRESS}} ("Calecute Technologies LLC", "we", "us"), and govern your use of the I Want USA app, the website at https://{{USA_WEB_DOMAIN}} and the seller dashboard (the "Service"). By creating an account or using the Service you agree to these Terms, our [Privacy Policy](/legal/privacy-policy) and our [Community Guidelines](/legal/community-guidelines). If you use the Service as a seller, our [Seller Terms](/legal/seller-terms) also apply.

**Please read Section 14 carefully. It contains a binding arbitration agreement and class action waiver that affect how disputes are resolved.**

## 1. What I Want USA is

I Want USA is an online marketplace that lets people and businesses in the United States ("buyers") post requests for products and services, and lets independent businesses ("sellers") send quotes in response.

**Calecute Technologies LLC is not a party to any transaction between a buyer and a seller.** We do not sell, manufacture, stock, deliver, install or inspect any product, and we do not perform any service listed on the Service. Sellers are independent businesses, not our employees, agents or partners. We do not guarantee the quality, safety, legality, timing or price of any item or service, the accuracy of any quote, request or listing, or that a buyer or seller will complete a transaction. Any contract for goods or services is made directly between the buyer and the seller.

## 2. Eligibility and accounts

- You must be at least 18 years old and able to form a binding contract. The Service is not for children.
- You must live in, or (for sellers) operate a business in, the United States.
- You sign in with a phone number verified by one-time code, Google or Apple. Keep your account secure; you are responsible for activity under it. Tell us at {{SUPPORT_EMAIL}} if you suspect unauthorized use.
- Give accurate information and keep it up to date. One person may hold one buyer account; a business may hold one seller profile unless we agree otherwise.

## 3. Posting requests (buyers)

- Describe what you want honestly and only post requests you genuinely intend to consider. Requests cannot be for blocked categories listed in the [Community Guidelines](/legal/community-guidelines).
- You may set a budget (and hide it from sellers), a needed-by date, a location and a quote window. Matching sellers are notified; up to 10 quotes may be received per request.
- Your exact address and phone number are shared only with the seller whose quote you accept.
- Accepting a quote closes the request to new quotes and tells the seller you want to proceed. It is not a payment. You and the seller then agree the final details directly.

## 4. Quotes, payment and delivery

- Quotes are offers made by sellers. A seller is responsible for its quote, including price, taxes (sales tax may apply), delivery or installation charges, warranty and validity.
- In the current version of the Service, **payment is made directly between buyer and seller** (for example card, cash or Zelle) outside the Service. We do not hold, process or guarantee buyer payments, and we are not responsible for refunds between buyers and sellers. Never pay a seller you have not verified, and never send money by gift card or wire to someone you have not met.
- Problems with an order (late delivery, defects, warranty) must be resolved with the seller. You can report a seller to us and we may take action under our Community Guidelines, but we are not obliged to resolve disputes between users.

## 5. Reviews

Only buyers whose order is marked completed may review a seller. Reviews must be honest, based on your own experience and follow the Community Guidelines. We do not accept payment to change, rank or remove reviews; we remove reviews only if they break our rules or the law. Sellers may reply publicly once.

## 6. Your content

You keep ownership of what you post (requests, photos, chat messages, reviews, profile content). You give Calecute Technologies LLC a worldwide, non-exclusive, royalty-free licence to host, store, reproduce, display, adapt (for example resize or translate) and distribute your content only to operate, improve and promote the Service, for as long as it is on the Service and for a reasonable time after removal (for backups and legal holds). You confirm you have the right to post it.

## 7. Rules of conduct

You must follow the [Community Guidelines](/legal/community-guidelines). In particular, you must not: post blocked items or services; offer restricted services without the required licence; post false, misleading or duplicate requests or quotes; harass, threaten or discriminate against anyone; post sexual, violent or hateful content; spam, scrape or use bots; collect other users' data; circumvent rate limits or security; impersonate anyone; or use the Service for any unlawful purpose. We use automated tools and human review to detect abuse.

## 8. Reporting, blocking and moderation

Every chat, request, quote, review and profile has a **Report** and **Block** option. We review reports and may remove content, limit features, suspend or close accounts, and preserve information for law enforcement. Content that receives multiple reports may be hidden automatically while we review it. If we act against your account you can appeal by writing to {{SUPPORT_EMAIL}}.

## 9. Fees

The Service is free for buyers. Sellers may be charged for plans and quote credits as described in the [Seller Terms](/legal/seller-terms), [Subscription Terms](/legal/subscription-terms) and [Refund and Cancellation Policy](/legal/refund-cancellation).

## 10. Third-party services

The Service uses third-party services such as Google Maps, Google and Apple sign-in, Google Play, the App Store and Stripe. Your use of them is subject to their terms, including the Google Maps/Google Earth Additional Terms of Service and Google's Privacy Policy. If you downloaded the app from the Apple App Store, the [EULA](/legal/eula) terms also apply.

## 11. Intellectual property

The Service, including its software, design, logos and the names "I Want USA" and "I Want", belongs to Calecute Technologies LLC or its licensors. We grant you a personal, revocable, non-transferable licence to use the app for its intended purpose. If you believe content on the Service infringes your copyright, send a notice under the Digital Millennium Copyright Act to {{SUPPORT_EMAIL}} with the subject "DMCA notice" including the information required by 17 U.S.C. § 512(c)(3).

## 12. Disclaimers

THE SERVICE IS PROVIDED "AS IS" AND "AS AVAILABLE". TO THE FULLEST EXTENT PERMITTED BY LAW, Calecute Technologies LLC DISCLAIMS ALL WARRANTIES, EXPRESS OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING MERCHANTABILITY, FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE, TITLE AND NON-INFRINGEMENT, AND ANY WARRANTY ABOUT USERS, SELLERS, QUOTES, PRODUCTS OR SERVICES OBTAINED THROUGH THE SERVICE. Licence checks and "Verified" badges reflect information available to us at the time of the check and are not a guarantee or endorsement.

## 13. Limitation of liability and indemnity

TO THE FULLEST EXTENT PERMITTED BY LAW, Calecute Technologies LLC WILL NOT BE LIABLE FOR ANY INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL, SPECIAL, CONSEQUENTIAL OR PUNITIVE DAMAGES, OR FOR ANY LOSS ARISING FROM A TRANSACTION OR DISPUTE BETWEEN USERS. OUR TOTAL LIABILITY FOR ANY CLAIM RELATING TO THE SERVICE IS LIMITED TO THE GREATER OF US$100 OR THE AMOUNT YOU PAID US IN THE 12 MONTHS BEFORE THE CLAIM. Some states do not allow these limits, so they may not apply to you. You agree to indemnify Calecute Technologies LLC against claims arising from your content, your transactions with other users or your breach of these Terms.

## 14. Dispute resolution: arbitration and class action waiver

**Informal resolution.** Before filing a claim, contact {{SUPPORT_EMAIL}} and try to resolve it informally for 60 days.

**Arbitration.** Except for small-claims cases and claims for injunctive relief about intellectual property, any dispute between you and Calecute Technologies LLC relating to the Service will be resolved by binding individual arbitration administered by the American Arbitration Association under its Consumer Arbitration Rules. The Federal Arbitration Act governs this section. The arbitration will take place in the county where you live or by video, or in {{ARBITRATION_COUNTY}} if you agree.

**Class action waiver.** You and Calecute Technologies LLC may bring claims only on an individual basis, not as a plaintiff or class member in any class, collective or representative proceeding.

**Opt-out.** You may opt out of this arbitration agreement within 30 days of first accepting these Terms by emailing {{SUPPORT_EMAIL}} with the subject "Arbitration opt-out" and your account phone number.

## 15. Suspension and termination

You can stop using the Service and delete your account at any time (see [Account Deletion](/legal/account-deletion)). We may suspend or end your access if you break these Terms, if required by law, or to protect users. Sections 6 (licence for backups and legal holds), 11 to 16 survive termination.

## 16. General

These Terms are governed by the laws of the State of {{GOVERNING_STATE}} and applicable US federal law, without regard to conflict-of-law rules. Subject to Section 14, the state and federal courts located in {{GOVERNING_STATE}} have exclusive jurisdiction. If any provision is unenforceable, the rest remains in effect. We may update these Terms; we will notify you in the app of material changes at least 15 days before they take effect (except changes required by law), and ask you to accept them again. You may not assign these Terms; we may assign them to a successor.

## 17. Contact

Calecute Technologies LLC, {{US_BUSINESS_ADDRESS}} · {{SUPPORT_EMAIL}}

# Privacy Policy

_Version 1.0.0 · Last updated 2026-10-02_

This Privacy Policy explains how Calecute Technologies LLC ("Calecute Technologies LLC", "we", "us") collects, uses, shares and protects personal information when you use the I Want USA mobile app for Android and iOS, the website at https://{{USA_WEB_DOMAIN}} and the seller dashboard at https://{{USA_SELLER_DASHBOARD_DOMAIN}} (together, the "Service").

I Want USA is a reverse marketplace for the United States: buyers post what they want and independent sellers send quotes. I Want USA is a separate app from "I Want India"; the two apps share no accounts and no data.

If you are a California resident, also read our [California Privacy Notice](/legal/ccpa-notice), which forms part of this policy. Our [Children's Privacy (COPPA) Statement](/legal/coppa) explains why the Service is not for children.

## 1. Summary

- We collect what we need to run the marketplace: your account and phone number, the requests and quotes you post, chat messages, photos you upload, the location you choose for a request, and basic device, crash and usage data.
- We **do not sell** your personal information and we **do not share** it for cross-context behavioral advertising. The app shows **no ads**, does **not track** you across other companies' apps or websites, and does not use the Android Advertising ID or Apple's IDFA.
- Your data is stored by our database provider Supabase in **AWS us-east-1 (N. Virginia, United States)**.
- A buyer's exact address and phone number are shown to a seller **only after the buyer accepts that seller's quote**.
- You can delete your account at any time in **Settings > Delete account** or at [https://{{USA_WEB_DOMAIN}}/legal/account-deletion](/legal/account-deletion).

## 2. Information we collect

The table below is the complete list of data the app collects. It is the same list we declare in the Google Play **Data safety** form and in Apple's **App Privacy** labels.

| Data | Examples | Source | Required? | Why we use it |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Name | Display name; business name for sellers | You, or Google / Apple sign-in | Required | Account, showing who sent a request or quote |
| Email address | Address from Google or Apple sign-in (may be an Apple relay address), or one you add | You, Google, Apple | Optional | Account management, receipts, service messages, support, marketing emails only if you opt in |
| Phone number | Your mobile number, verified by one-time code | You | Required | Sign-in, fraud prevention, shared with the seller you accept (buyers) or the buyer who accepts you (sellers), marketing messages only if you opt in |
| Address | Delivery or service address; seller business address | You | Required to post a request or verify as a seller | Matching requests to nearby sellers, delivery, seller verification |
| Precise location | GPS position when you tap "Use my location" | Your device, only with your permission and only while the app is in use | Optional | Placing a request pin, distance to sellers, seller service area |
| Approximate location | ZIP code, city, locality derived from your address or GPS | You, your device | Required to post a request | Matching and showing sellers the area of a request (never the exact address before acceptance); city-level analytics (Firebase Analytics derives it from your IP address) |
| User ID | Our internal account ID | Generated by us | Required | Account management, linking your requests, quotes and chats |
| Device or other IDs | Push notification token, Firebase installation ID, App Check token | Your device, Firebase | Required | Sending notifications, analytics, fraud and abuse prevention |
| Messages | In-app chat between buyers and sellers, counter-offers, messages you send to our support team from the app | You | Optional | Providing chat and customer support, safety (reports, spam and scam detection) |
| Photos and videos | Request photos, seller and shop photos, review photos | You, through the system photo picker or camera | Optional | Showing your request, profile or review |
| Files and documents | Seller verification and licence documents | You | Required for verification or restricted categories | Seller verification, licence checks, fraud prevention |
| Other user content | Request text (typed or dictated), quotes, reviews, reports, business profile, licence numbers, EIN or state business licence number | You | Required to use the features | Providing the marketplace, verification, safety |
| Purchase history | Seller plans and quote-credit packs bought, renewals, refunds | Google Play, Apple, Stripe | Required for sellers who buy | Granting and managing seller entitlements, accounting |
| App interactions | Screens viewed, buttons tapped, requests posted, quotes sent | Firebase Analytics, Google Maps SDK | Firebase Analytics events are optional (on by default; Settings > Privacy > Analytics). Basic map usage data is collected by the Google Maps SDK whenever you use a map | Analytics to improve the app; map features |
| Crash logs | Stack traces at the time of a crash | Firebase Crashlytics | Required | Fixing crashes |
| Diagnostics | App version, OS version, device model, performance and error data | Firebase Crashlytics, Supabase | Required | Fixing bugs, keeping the Service stable |

**What we do not collect:** contacts, calendar, SMS or call logs, health or fitness data, web browsing history, background location, the Android Advertising ID or Apple's IDFA, or payment card numbers (cards are entered only on Google Play, Apple, or Stripe's own payment pages; we receive only a payment reference, plan, amount and status). The microphone is used only for voice input: speech is converted to text by your device's speech-recognition service (Apple or Google) and we receive the text, not the audio.

**Information we receive from others:** your name and email from Google or Apple if you use their sign-in; payment status from Google Play, Apple and Stripe; licence status from public licensing databases (for example the NIPR producer database or state licensing boards) when you are a seller in a restricted category; reports about you from other users.

**Website and seller dashboard:** our websites collect the IP address, browser type and pages requested in server logs, and use the cookies described in our [Cookie Policy](/legal/cookie-policy).

## 3. How we use information

We use personal information to:

1. Create and secure your account and sign you in (phone one-time code, Google or Apple).
2. Run the marketplace: post requests, match them to sellers by category and service area, deliver quotes, chat, accept quotes, track orders and publish reviews.
3. Verify sellers, check licences for restricted categories and show "Verified" badges.
4. Send notifications you asked for (new quotes, messages, order updates) and service messages. Marketing messages are sent only if you opt in, and you can opt out at any time.
5. Keep the Service safe: detect fake or duplicate requests, spam, scams and abuse; enforce our [Terms of Service](/legal/terms-of-service) and [Community Guidelines](/legal/community-guidelines); handle reports and blocks; moderate uploaded photos.
6. Process seller plan and quote-credit purchases and keep accounting and tax records.
7. Analyze aggregated usage and fix crashes and bugs.
8. Comply with law and respond to lawful requests.

We do not use automated decision-making that produces legal or similarly significant effects. Seller ranking in quote lists is explained in our [Seller Terms](/legal/seller-terms).

## 4. What other users see

- **Sellers matching your request** see its category, description, photos, quantity, needed-by date, your budget (unless you hide it), the locality or ZIP code (not the exact address) and your display name.
- **After you accept a quote**, that seller also sees your exact address and phone number so they can deliver or provide the service. Before acceptance, contact happens only through in-app chat.
- **Seller profiles** (business name, photos, description, categories, service area, rating, reviews, verification badge and licence numbers for restricted categories) are public.
- **Reviews** you write are public with your display name.

## 5. Service providers that receive data

We share personal information only with service providers that process it on our behalf under contract, with other users as described above, and where required by law. Our service providers are:

| Provider | Purpose | Data | Location |
|---|---|---|---|
| Supabase, Inc. (on Amazon Web Services) | Database, authentication, file storage, realtime chat, server functions | All account and marketplace data | AWS us-east-1 (N. Virginia, United States) |
| Google Firebase (Google LLC): Cloud Messaging, Crashlytics, Analytics, Remote Config, App Check | Push notifications, crash reports, usage analytics, feature settings, app integrity | Device IDs, push tokens, crash and diagnostics data, app interactions, user ID | United States and other Google locations |
| Google Maps Platform (Maps SDK, Places, Geocoding) | Maps, address search and conversion of addresses to coordinates | Address text, map position, IP address | Google locations |
| Google Cloud Vision | Automated screening of uploaded images for unsafe content | Uploaded photos | Google locations |
| Google Sign-In and Sign in with Apple | Sign-in | Name, email, sign-in token | Google / Apple |
| Twilio Verify (Twilio Inc.) | Sending one-time sign-in codes | Phone number | United States |
| Google Play Billing and Apple App Store | In-app purchase of seller plans and credits | Purchase records | Google / Apple |
| Stripe, Inc. | Web payments for seller plans and credits; payouts to our Mercury bank account | Name, email, purchase details (card details go directly to Stripe) | United States |
| Vercel Inc. | Hosting our websites and seller dashboard | IP address, server logs | United States |
| Cloudflare Turnstile and Upstash | Bot protection and rate limiting on forms and APIs | IP address, browser signals, user ID | United States and other locations |
| Our email delivery provider (Resend or Brevo) | Sending receipts, service and opted-in emails | Email address, message content | United States / EU |

Service providers may not use your information for their own purposes except as their own privacy terms allow for security and service improvement. We may also disclose information (a) to comply with law, a subpoena or court order, (b) to protect the rights, safety or property of users, the public or Calecute Technologies LLC, including fraud prevention, or (c) to a buyer or successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of assets, subject to this policy.

## 6. Retention

| Data | How long we keep it |
|---|---|
| Account and profile | While your account is open; deleted or anonymized within 30 days after you delete it |
| Requests, quotes, chats, photos | While your account is open; deleted or anonymized within 30 days after account deletion. The other party keeps their own copy of a completed order record, with your details anonymized |
| Reviews | Kept with your name removed after account deletion so seller ratings stay accurate |
| Seller verification and licence documents | While you are a seller, plus 12 months after you stop, for fraud prevention |
| Purchase and invoice records | 7 years, to meet tax and accounting law |
| Reports, blocks, suspensions | Up to 3 years, to prevent banned users from returning |
| Consent records | While the consent is active plus 3 years |
| Analytics data | 14 months |
| Crash reports | 90 days |
| Server and security logs | 90 days |
| Backups | Overwritten within 35 days |

## 7. Your choices and rights

All users can:

- **Access and download** your data: Settings > Privacy > Download my data, or email {{PRIVACY_EMAIL}}.
- **Correct** your profile in the app, or ask us to correct other data.
- **Delete** your account and data: Settings > Delete account, or the [Account Deletion page](/legal/account-deletion).
- **Turn off analytics** in Settings > Privacy, **turn off notifications** in Settings > Notifications or your device settings, and **withdraw location, camera, photo or microphone permission** in your device settings.
- **Opt out of marketing** using the unsubscribe link or Settings > Notifications.

Residents of California, Colorado, Connecticut, Delaware, Iowa, Montana, Nebraska, New Hampshire, New Jersey, Oregon, Texas, Utah, Virginia and other states with consumer privacy laws have the rights those laws give, which may include the rights to know, access, correct, delete, obtain a portable copy, opt out of sale, targeted advertising and profiling, and to appeal our decision. We do not sell personal information, do not process it for targeted advertising, and do not profile in furtherance of decisions with legal or similarly significant effects. To exercise a right, email {{PRIVACY_EMAIL}} or use the in-app options above. We will verify your request by confirming control of your account phone number or email, and respond within 45 days (extendable once by 45 days where the law allows). If we decline your request you may appeal by replying to our decision with the subject "Appeal"; we will answer within the period the law requires, and if you are not satisfied you may contact your state Attorney General. We will not discriminate against you for exercising your rights. We honor the Global Privacy Control (GPC) signal on our websites as an opt-out of sale and sharing.

## 8. Security

Data is encrypted in transit (TLS) and at rest by our hosting provider. Access is controlled by row-level security rules so users can only read the data they are allowed to see; verification documents are stored in private storage. Staff access is limited and logged. No system is perfectly secure; if a breach affects your personal information we will notify you and regulators as the law requires.

## 9. Children

The Service is for adults. You must be at least 18 to create an account, and the Service is not directed to children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If we learn that we have, we delete it promptly. See our [COPPA Statement](/legal/coppa). Parents who believe their child has given us information should contact {{PRIVACY_EMAIL}}.

## 10. International users

I Want USA is offered only in the United States. Some service providers (for example Google) may process data outside the United States under their own safeguards.

## 11. Changes

We will post changes on this page and update the version and date above. If a change is material we will tell you in the app and, where the law requires, ask for your consent again before it applies to you.

## 12. Contact

Calecute Technologies LLC
{{US_BUSINESS_ADDRESS}}
Privacy questions and requests: {{PRIVACY_EMAIL}}
Support: {{SUPPORT_EMAIL}} · [Contact and Support](/legal/contact-support)

# Your California Privacy Rights

_Version 1.0.0 · Last updated 2026-10-02_

This notice supplements our [Privacy Policy](/legal/privacy-policy) and applies to residents of California under the California Consumer Privacy Act as amended by the California Privacy Rights Act (together, "CCPA"). It is provided by Calecute Technologies LLC, {{US_BUSINESS_ADDRESS}}.

## Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information

**Calecute Technologies LLC does not sell your personal information and does not share it for cross-context behavioral advertising, and has not done so in the past 12 months.** We have no actual knowledge of selling or sharing the personal information of consumers under 16. I Want USA shows no ads and uses no advertising identifiers.

Even so, you can record an opt-out so it applies if our practices ever change:

- In the app: **Settings > Privacy > Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information**
- On the web: the **"Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information"** link in the footer of https://{{USA_WEB_DOMAIN}} (it opens this section and an opt-out form)
- By email to {{PRIVACY_EMAIL}} with the subject "Do Not Sell or Share"
- By enabling the **Global Privacy Control** (GPC) signal in your browser, which we honor on our websites

We will not ask you to opt back in for at least 12 months after you opt out.

## Categories of personal information we collect (last 12 months)

| CCPA category | Examples from I Want USA | Source | Business purpose | Disclosed to (service providers / contractors) | Sold or shared |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Identifiers | Name, phone number, email, account ID, push token, Firebase installation ID, IP address | You, your device, Google/Apple sign-in | Account, security, notifications, analytics | Supabase, Google Firebase, Twilio, Vercel, email provider | No |
| Customer records (Cal. Civ. Code § 1798.80(e)) | Name, address, phone number | You | Delivery, seller verification | Supabase, Google Maps Platform | No |
| Commercial information | Requests, quotes, orders, seller plans and credits purchased | You, Google Play, Apple, Stripe | Marketplace, billing, accounting | Supabase, Stripe, Google, Apple | No |
| Internet or other electronic network activity | App interactions, crash and diagnostic data, website logs | Your device, Firebase, Vercel | Analytics, debugging, security | Google Firebase, Vercel | No |
| Geolocation data | Precise location (only when you choose "Use my location"), ZIP code | Your device, you | Matching requests with nearby sellers | Supabase, Google Maps Platform | No |
| Audio, electronic, visual or similar information | Photos and videos you upload (voice input is converted to text on your device's speech service; we do not receive audio) | You | Showing requests, profiles, reviews; safety screening | Supabase, Google Cloud Vision | No |
| Professional or employment-related information | Business name, EIN or state business licence, professional licences (insurance, bar, real estate, contractor) | You (sellers), public licence databases | Seller verification and licence checks | Supabase | No |
| Inferences | None. We do not create profiles about your preferences or characteristics | | | | No |
| Sensitive personal information | Precise geolocation; account login (phone with one-time code) | You, your device | Only to provide the services you request and for security, as permitted by Cal. Code Regs. tit. 11, § 7027(m) | Supabase, Google Maps Platform | No |

We do not use or disclose sensitive personal information for purposes other than those permitted by the CCPA, so we do not offer a "Limit the Use of My Sensitive Personal Information" link. Retention periods for each category are listed in Section 6 of the Privacy Policy.

## Your rights

As a California resident you have the right to:

- **Know and access** the categories and specific pieces of personal information we have collected, its sources, purposes and the categories of recipients
- **Delete** personal information we collected from you, subject to legal exceptions
- **Correct** inaccurate personal information
- **Opt out of sale or sharing** (see above)
- **Limit the use of sensitive personal information** (we already limit it to permitted purposes)
- **Not be discriminated or retaliated against** for exercising your rights. We do not offer financial incentives tied to personal information

## How to submit a request

- In the app: **Settings > Privacy** (Download my data, Delete account, Do Not Sell or Share)
- Email: {{PRIVACY_EMAIL}}
- Toll-free or other phone line: {{SUPPORT_PHONE}}

We verify requests by sending a one-time code to the phone number on the account, or by matching information you give us with information we hold. We confirm receipt within 10 business days and respond within 45 days (we may extend once by 45 days and will tell you why). An **authorized agent** may submit a request with your signed permission or a power of attorney; we may ask you to verify your identity directly.

## Shine the Light

California Civil Code § 1798.83 lets California residents ask for information about disclosure of personal information to third parties for their direct marketing purposes. We do not disclose personal information to third parties for their direct marketing purposes.

## Metrics

We will publish the number of CCPA requests received, complied with and denied, and median response time, for each calendar year in which we are required to do so.

## Contact

Calecute Technologies LLC, {{US_BUSINESS_ADDRESS}} · {{PRIVACY_EMAIL}}

title: Children's Privacy (COPPA) Statement
markdown:
# Children's Privacy (COPPA) Statement

_Version 1.0.0 · Last updated 2026-10-02_

I Want USA is a marketplace for adults to request and quote for products and services. It is **not directed to children under 13**, and you must be at least 18 years old to create an account.

## Our practices

- We do not knowingly collect, use or disclose personal information from children under 13, as defined by the Children's Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA) and the FTC's COPPA Rule.
- Sign-up includes an age confirmation. Users who indicate they are under 18 cannot create an account.
- The app has no ads, no behavioral advertising and no third-party tracking, and the app's store listings target adults (Google Play target audience: 18 and over).
- Content rules in our [Community Guidelines](/legal/community-guidelines) prohibit any content that sexualizes or endangers minors; such content is removed and reported to the National Center for Missing & Exploited Children (NCMEC) as required by law.

## If a child has given us information

If we learn that we have collected personal information from a child under 13, we will delete it and close the account promptly, without first seeking parental consent, as permitted by the COPPA Rule. We will not use it for any purpose other than responding to the deletion.

Parents or guardians who believe their child has used I Want USA or provided personal information can contact us at **{{PRIVACY_EMAIL}}** (subject "Child privacy") with the account's phone number or email, and we will investigate and delete the data. We will tell you when this is done.

## Teens

Users aged 13 to 17 may not create accounts either. If we learn that a user is under 18, we close the account and delete its data under our [Privacy Policy](/legal/privacy-policy).

## Contact

Calecute Technologies LLC, {{US_BUSINESS_ADDRESS}} · {{PRIVACY_EMAIL}}

title: Community Guidelines and Prohibited and Restricted Items
markdown:
# Community Guidelines and Prohibited and Restricted Items

_Version 1.0.0 · Last updated 2026-10-02_

I Want USA works when buyers post real needs and sellers send honest quotes. These guidelines apply to everything on the Service: requests, quotes, chat, photos, profiles and reviews. They form part of our [Terms of Service](/legal/terms-of-service) and [Seller Terms](/legal/seller-terms).

## 1. Be honest and respectful

- Post genuine requests and quotes. No fake, duplicate or test requests, bait prices or quotes for items you cannot supply.
- Treat everyone with respect. No harassment, threats, bullying, hate speech, or discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, age, familial status or any other protected characteristic.
- No sexual or sexually suggestive content, nudity, adult services, or content involving minors in any sexual or harmful way.
- No violent, graphic or shocking content.
- No spam, chain messages, unrelated advertising, link farming or scams (for example advance-fee requests, gift-card payments or fake overpayment checks).
- Do not share other people's personal information. Do not ask buyers for passwords, one-time codes or bank logins.
- Do not impersonate any person or business, or misrepresent your licences, ratings or affiliation.
- Do not post content that infringes intellectual property, including counterfeit or replica goods.

## 2. Allowed, restricted and blocked categories

Every category has one of three states:

- **Allowed**: anyone can request and any verified seller can quote.
- **Restricted (licensed sellers only)**: buyers can request, but only sellers who upload and pass review of the required licence can see or quote these requests. The licence type, number, issuing body and expiry are stored and re-checked before expiry. Request and quote screens show the regulatory disclaimer for the category.
- **Blocked**: cannot be requested or quoted at all. Our text classifier also catches free-text requests that try to get around this.

When we are unsure whether a category is lawful to offer, it starts as **Blocked**. The current policy for I Want USA is:

| Category | Policy | At launch | Who may quote / licence rule |
|---|---|---|---|
| Insurance (health, motor/auto, life, home) | Restricted (licensed sellers only) | **Blocked** until legal sign-off | State-licensed insurance producer (agent or broker) whose licence is valid in the buyer's state, checked against the NIPR producer database. |
| Loans, credit and credit cards | Blocked | Same | Not available (state lending licences and federal consumer credit rules). |
| Investments, securities and crypto-assets | Blocked | Same | Not available (SEC / FINRA rules). |
| Real estate sale and rental | Restricted (licensed sellers only) | Same | Real estate broker or salesperson licence issued by the state where the property is located. |
| Legal services | Restricted (licensed sellers only) | Same | Attorney with active admission to the bar of the state whose law governs the matter; bar number and state shown on the profile. |
| Medical providers, doctors and clinics | Restricted (licensed sellers only) | Same | Provider licensed by the relevant state board for the services quoted. No telehealth prescribing and no prescriptions through the app. |
| Medicines and pharmacy (prescription or OTC) | Blocked | Same | Not available. |
| Alcohol, tobacco, vapes and cannabis | Blocked | Same | Not available. |
| Firearms, ammunition, weapons and weapon parts | Blocked | Same | Not available. |
| Contractors (electrical, plumbing, HVAC, roofing, general) | Restricted (licensed sellers only) | Same | Contractor licence where the buyer's state (or locality) requires one for the job; licence number, classification and expiry shown on the quote. |
| Moving (local and interstate) | Allowed | Same | Interstate movers must show a valid USDOT number (and FMCSA MC number where required); intrastate rules vary by state. |
| Used vehicles | Allowed | Same | Dealer licence number optional (shown if provided). Private sellers must disclose known defects and title status. |
| Everyday goods (appliances, electronics, furniture) and home services | Allowed | Same | None beyond seller verification (EIN or state business licence). |

## 3. Always prohibited

Regardless of category, you may not request, offer or quote for:

- Weapons, firearms, ammunition, explosives, weapon parts and accessories designed to make weapons more lethal.
- Drugs, controlled substances, drug paraphernalia, prescription and over-the-counter medicines, and cannabis products.
- Alcohol, tobacco, vapes and nicotine products.
- Counterfeit, replica or stolen goods, and goods that infringe a trademark, copyright or patent.
- Adult or sexual services, escort services, and any content sexualizing minors.
- Loans, credit repair, debt settlement, investments, securities, cryptocurrency and money transmission.
- Gambling, lotteries and sweepstakes.
- Human remains, body parts, live animals protected by law, and products made from endangered species.
- Recalled products, hazardous materials and products banned by the Consumer Product Safety Commission.
- Fake documents, identity documents, academic cheating, hacking services, personal data or accounts.
- Services that would require you to break the law, including unlicensed regulated services.

## 4. Regulatory disclaimers

These disclaimers are shown on request and quote screens in the categories they apply to:

- **Insurance (health, motor/auto, life, home):** Insurance quotes are provided by independently licensed insurance producers, not by Calecute Technologies LLC. Calecute Technologies LLC is not an insurance agency or producer and does not sell, solicit or negotiate insurance. Coverage, eligibility and prices are determined by the insurer. Producer licence number: <shown on each quote>.
- **Real estate sale and rental:** Real estate services are provided by independently licensed brokers and agents. All listings and quotes are subject to the federal Fair Housing Act: we do not allow any preference, limitation or discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex, handicap, familial status or national origin, or any other class protected by state or local law.
- **Legal services:** ATTORNEY ADVERTISING. Quotes are provided by independent attorneys, not by Calecute Technologies LLC, which is not a law firm, does not provide legal advice and does not refer or recommend lawyers. Sending a request or receiving a quote does not create an attorney-client relationship. Prior results do not guarantee a similar outcome.
- **Medical providers, doctors and clinics:** I Want USA does not provide medical advice, diagnosis or treatment and is not a healthcare provider. Do not share detailed health information in requests or chat. In an emergency call 911.
- **Contractors (electrical, plumbing, HVAC, roofing, general):** Licensing requirements vary by state and job size. Check the contractor's licence with your state licensing board before work starts. Permits may be required.
- **Moving (local and interstate):** Interstate moves are regulated by FMCSA. Ask for the mover's USDOT number and the "Your Rights and Responsibilities When You Move" booklet.
- **Used vehicles:** Check the vehicle history and title before you pay. Used vehicles sold by dealers must display the FTC Buyers Guide.
- **Everyday goods (appliances, electronics, furniture) and home services:** Sales tax may apply. Prices are set by the seller.

## 5. Reviews

Reviews must reflect a real, completed order. No paid, incentivized, swapped or self-written reviews, and no threats to leave a bad review to get a discount. Sellers may reply once, politely.

## 6. Enforcement

You can **report** and **block** any user, request, quote, chat or review. Content with several reports may be hidden automatically while we review it. Uploaded photos are screened automatically for unsafe content. Depending on severity we may remove content, issue a warning, limit features, remove a Verified badge, or suspend or close the account, and we may report illegal content to law enforcement. You can appeal by writing to {{SUPPORT_EMAIL}}.

If you see something that puts someone in immediate danger, call 911.

# Seller Terms

_Version 1.0.0 · Last updated 2026-10-02_

These Seller Terms form part of the [Terms of Service](/legal/terms-of-service) and apply when you use I Want USA as a seller ("you"). If you accept them on behalf of a business, you confirm you are authorized to bind it. If anything here conflicts with the Terms of Service, these Seller Terms apply to your seller activity.

## 1. Who can sell

- You must be a business or self-employed professional lawfully operating in the United States, at least 18 years old, with a phone number verified by one-time code.
- You are an independent business. Nothing in these terms creates an employment, agency, partnership or joint-venture relationship with Calecute Technologies LLC.

## 2. Verification and licences

- To earn a **Verified** badge you must provide an EIN or a state business licence number, a business address and, optionally, a website. We review submissions manually and may ask for more documents.
- For **restricted categories** (see the [Community Guidelines](/legal/community-guidelines)) you must upload the licence the category requires (for example a state insurance producer licence valid in the buyer's state, active state bar admission, a state real estate licence, a state contractor licence where the buyer's state requires one, a USDOT number for interstate moves). We store the licence type, number, issuing body and expiry, re-check it before expiry, and hide restricted requests from you if a licence lapses or cannot be verified.
- You must keep verification information accurate and tell us within 7 days if a licence is suspended, revoked or expires.
- A badge means we checked the information available to us at that time. It is not an endorsement or guarantee.

## 3. Lead feed and quoting rules

- You see open requests that match your categories and service area. Requests show the locality or ZIP code, not the buyer's exact address or contact details.
- Each request accepts up to 10 quotes, first come, first served. New requests may first be shown only to Verified sellers for a short priority window (currently 15 minutes).
- Your quote must be complete and honest: price per item, quantity, sales tax, delivery or installation charges, total, brand and model offered, delivery or service date, warranty and validity. The total shown to the buyer is the amount you expect to be paid. Do not quote an item you cannot supply or a lower "bait" price you will not honor.
- Honor an accepted quote at the quoted price for its validity period, unless the buyer changes the request.
- Before a buyer accepts your quote, communicate through in-app chat. Asking buyers to move off the platform before acceptance, or sharing contact details to avoid the platform, may lead to warnings or suspension.
- After acceptance you receive the buyer's address and phone number. Use them **only** to complete that order. You must not add buyers to marketing lists, sell or share their information, or contact them by text or autodialed calls for marketing without their prior express written consent as required by the Telephone Consumer Protection Act.
- You are responsible for collecting payment, issuing receipts, charging and remitting sales tax, warranties, returns and complying with all laws that apply to your business and your products or services (including consumer protection, licensing, permits and product safety laws).
- We may set rate limits (for example maximum quotes per hour) and remove quotes that break these terms.

## 4. Fees, launch period and early partners

- **Launch period.** While monetization is switched off, all seller features are free and no paywall is shown.
- **Founding partners.** Sellers who join before monetization starts are marked as early partners and keep free access until **{{EARLY_PARTNER_FREE_UNTIL}}**, shown as "Founding partner: free until <date>" in the app. This is not a promise of free access for life.
- **After monetization starts**, sellers get 5 free quotes per month. Beyond that you can buy a **seller subscription** (monthly or annual; higher or unlimited quote limits, Verified-first priority window, featured placement and analytics) or **quote-credit packs**. Prices, billing periods, renewal and cancellation are shown before purchase and explained in the [Subscription Terms](/legal/subscription-terms) and [Refund and Cancellation Policy](/legal/refund-cancellation).
- Payments are processed by Google Play, Apple, or Stripe on our seller dashboard at https://{{USA_SELLER_DASHBOARD_DOMAIN}}. We will give at least 30 days' notice of any new fee or price increase that affects you.
- We do not take a commission on buyer-to-seller payments in the current version of the Service. If we introduce in-app payments or commission in the future, we will ask you to accept updated terms first.

## 5. Ranking and sponsored placement

We want buyers to see a fair comparison. This section explains the main parameters that decide where your quotes and profile appear.

- **Quote lists** for a buyer are sorted by the option the buyer chooses (price, rating, delivery date or distance). The default order considers total price, delivery date, distance, your rating and number of completed orders, your response time, and whether you are Verified.
- **Lead feed** order is newest first, filtered by category and service area, with the Verified-first priority window described above.
- **Featured placement** is available to subscribers after monetization starts. Featured profiles and quotes are always clearly labelled **"Sponsored"**. Paying never changes a buyer's chosen sort order, your reviews or your rating.
- We do not accept payment to remove or alter reviews.

## 6. Prohibited items and conduct

You must not quote for blocked categories, quote in restricted categories without a verified licence, or break the [Community Guidelines](/legal/community-guidelines). Fake reviews, review swapping, incentivized reviews, shill accounts, price manipulation and harassment of buyers or other sellers are prohibited.

## 7. Content you provide

You grant us the licence in the Terms of Service to your business name, logo, photos and profile content, including to show your profile on our website, in search results and in promotional material for the Service. You confirm you own or may use any brand names, trademarks and images you upload.

## 8. Suspension and removal

We may warn you, hide your quotes, remove your badge, suspend or close your seller account if you break these terms, receive repeated well-founded complaints, a licence lapses, or we are required to by law. We will tell you why unless the law or safety prevents it, and you can appeal by writing to {{SUPPORT_EMAIL}}. Refunds after suspension follow the [Refund and Cancellation Policy](/legal/refund-cancellation).

## 9. Liability and indemnity

You are solely responsible for your products, services and quotes and for your dealings with buyers. You will indemnify Calecute Technologies LLC against claims arising from them or from your breach of these terms or the law. The disclaimers and limits of liability in the Terms of Service apply.

## 10. Contact

Seller support: {{SUPPORT_EMAIL}} · Calecute Technologies LLC, {{US_BUSINESS_ADDRESS}}

# Seller Subscription Terms

_Version 1.0.0 · Last updated 2026-10-02_

These terms are shown before you buy a seller plan or quote credits in I Want USA. They supplement the [Seller Terms](/legal/seller-terms) and the [Refund and Cancellation Policy](/legal/refund-cancellation). Buyers never pay to use I Want USA.

## 1. Launch period and founding partners

Seller features are currently free while monetization is off. Sellers who join before monetization starts are founding partners and keep free access until **{{EARLY_PARTNER_FREE_UNTIL}}**. You will not be charged unless you choose a plan, and we will tell you at least 30 days before any free access you have ends.

## 2. What you can buy

| Product | Billing | What you get |
|---|---|---|
| Seller plan, monthly | Every month, auto-renewing | Higher or unlimited monthly quote limit, Verified-first priority window on new requests, featured placement labelled "Sponsored", seller analytics |
| Seller plan, annual | Every 12 months, auto-renewing | Same as monthly, at a lower effective monthly price |
| Quote-credit pack | One-time purchase | A fixed number of extra quotes, valid for 12 months |

Without a plan, sellers get 5 free quotes per month once monetization starts. The exact price, currency (USD), billing period and any sales tax are shown on the purchase screen before you confirm. Prices can differ between Google Play, the App Store and our website.

## 3. Free trials and introductory offers

If a free trial or introductory price is offered, the purchase screen shows its length and the price you will pay when it ends. Unless you cancel before the trial or introductory period ends, the subscription converts to the regular price shown. Each seller account is eligible for one trial. We may also offer upgrade discounts, offer codes and win-back offers; their terms are shown with the offer.

## 4. Auto-renewal

- **App Store:** Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel subscriptions in your App Store account settings after purchase: https://apps.apple.com/account/subscriptions
- **Google Play:** The subscription renews automatically at the end of each period until cancelled. You can cancel, pause or resubscribe at any time in the Google Play subscription center: https://play.google.com/store/account/subscriptions?package=com.calecute.iwant.usa
- **Website (Stripe):** Your card is charged at the start of each period until you cancel in the seller dashboard at https://{{USA_SELLER_DASHBOARD_DOMAIN}}. We email a receipt for each charge and remind you before an annual plan renews.

## 5. How to cancel

Cancel in the store or dashboard where you subscribed (links above, or Settings > Seller plan > Manage subscription in the app). Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current period, and you keep your benefits until then. Deleting the app does not cancel a store subscription.

## 6. Failed payments, grace period and account hold

If a renewal payment fails, we keep your plan active during the store's grace period and show a "Fix your payment" banner. If payment is not fixed, Google Play may place the subscription on account hold and your plan benefits pause until payment succeeds.

## 7. Price changes

We will tell you before any price increase takes effect. For store subscriptions, Google Play and Apple will notify you and, where their rules require, ask for your consent; if you do not agree, the subscription ends at the end of the current period.

## 8. Restore purchases

If you reinstall the app or switch devices, use **Settings > Seller plan > Restore purchases**. Your plan is linked to your I Want USA account, so a plan bought on any platform works on all of them.

## 9. Terms

Purchases are subject to our [Terms of Service](/legal/terms-of-service), [Privacy Policy](/legal/privacy-policy) and, for App Store purchases, the [End User License Agreement](/legal/eula).

# Refund and Cancellation Policy

_Version 1.0.0 · Last updated 2026-10-02_

This policy covers payments made **to Calecute Technologies LLC** for I Want USA seller subscriptions and quote-credit packs. Buyers use I Want USA for free.

**Purchases between buyers and sellers are not covered.** Buyers pay sellers directly, outside the Service, so refunds, returns, cancellations and warranty claims for goods or services must be agreed with the seller under the seller's own policy and the law. You can report a seller who refuses to honor an accepted quote, and we may act against the seller under our [Community Guidelines](/legal/community-guidelines).

## 1. Where you bought determines who handles it

| Where you paid | How to cancel | How to ask for a refund |
|---|---|---|
| Google Play (Android app) | Google Play > Payments & subscriptions > Subscriptions, or the "Manage subscription" link in the app | Google handles refunds under the Google Play refund policy. Within 48 hours of purchase you can request one at play.google.com; after that, contact us and we will review it under Section 3 |
| Apple App Store (iOS app) | iPhone Settings > your name > Subscriptions, or the "Manage subscription" link in the app | Apple handles all refunds at reportaproblem.apple.com. We cannot issue refunds for App Store purchases |
| Our website (seller dashboard, paid with Stripe) | Seller dashboard > Billing > Cancel plan, or the Stripe customer portal link in your receipt | Email {{SUPPORT_EMAIL}}; we review it under Section 3 |

## 2. Cancelling a subscription

- You can cancel at any time. Cancellation stops the next renewal; you keep your plan benefits until the end of the period you already paid for.
- Deleting the app or your account does not cancel a Google Play or App Store subscription. Cancel it in the store first. Deleting your I Want USA account cancels website subscriptions automatically.
- If you cancel during a free trial, you will not be charged. Apple and Google may require you to cancel at least 24 hours before the trial ends.

## 3. Refunds for website purchases

- **Subscriptions.** Payments for a started billing period are non-refundable, except where required by law, for duplicate or mistaken charges, or if the Service was unavailable for a significant part of the period because of a fault on our side. We do not give partial refunds for unused time after cancellation.
- **Annual plans.** If you cancel an annual plan within 14 days of the initial purchase (not a renewal), we refund it in full.
- **Quote-credit packs.** Unused credit packs can be refunded within 14 days of purchase if no credits from the pack have been used. Credits expire 12 months after purchase.
- **Account suspension.** If we close your seller account because you broke our Terms, fees already paid are not refunded. If we close it without cause, we refund the unused part of any prepaid period.
- **Disputed charges.** Please contact us before disputing a charge with your bank so we can help.

## 4. How refunds are paid

Approved refunds for website purchases go back to the original payment method through Stripe, usually within 5 to 10 business days of approval, depending on your bank. Any unused credits or plan benefits linked to the refunded purchase are removed.

## 5. Contact

{{SUPPORT_EMAIL}} · Calecute Technologies LLC, {{US_BUSINESS_ADDRESS}}

# Delete Your I Want USA Account

_Version 1.0.0 · Last updated 2026-10-02_

This page explains how to delete your account in **I Want USA**, the app published by **Calecute Technologies LLC**, and what happens to your data. It works without the app installed.

## Option 1: in the app (fastest)

1. Open I Want USA and sign in.
2. Go to **Settings > Delete account**.
3. Read what will be deleted and kept, then confirm. For your security we ask you to sign in again (one-time code, Google or Apple).
4. Your account is closed immediately and the deletion completes within 30 days.

If you signed in with Apple, we also revoke I Want USA's access to your Apple ID.

## Option 2: without the app

Send a deletion request from this page's form at https://{{USA_WEB_DOMAIN}}/legal/account-deletion, or email **{{PRIVACY_EMAIL}}** with the subject "Delete my account" from the email linked to your account, or include your registered phone number. We will send a one-time code to your registered phone number to confirm the request is yours, and confirm when deletion is complete.

## Before you delete

- **Store subscriptions are not cancelled automatically.** Cancel a Google Play or App Store seller plan in the store first. Website plans are cancelled automatically.
- Open requests are closed and open quotes are withdrawn. Sellers you accepted will no longer be able to contact you through the app.
- Unused quote credits and plan time are lost and are not refunded, except as described in the [Refund and Cancellation Policy](/legal/refund-cancellation).

## What is deleted

Within 30 days we delete or irreversibly anonymize:

- Your profile: name, phone number, email, addresses, photo and saved locations
- Requests, quotes, chat messages and uploaded photos and videos
- Seller business profile, business photos and service area
- Notification tokens, device identifiers and preferences
- Analytics data linked to your account ID

Backups containing your data are overwritten within 35 days.

## What is kept, and for how long

Some data must be kept for legal, tax or safety reasons, with access restricted:

- Purchase and invoice records for seller plans and credits (kept 7 years for tax and accounting law)
- Seller verification and licence records (12 months after deletion, for fraud prevention)
- Records of reports, blocks and suspensions linked to your phone number (up to 3 years, to stop banned users from returning)
- Records of the consents you gave and withdrew (3 years)
- Server and security logs (deleted within 90 days)
- Reviews you wrote stay published without your name, so sellers' ratings stay accurate
- Order records held by the other party to a completed order show your details anonymized

## Delete some data without deleting your account

You can delete individual requests, photos and reviews in the app, clear saved addresses in Settings > Addresses, turn off analytics in Settings > Privacy, or email {{PRIVACY_EMAIL}} to ask us to delete specific data.

## Questions

Calecute Technologies LLC, {{US_BUSINESS_ADDRESS}} · {{PRIVACY_EMAIL}}

title: Cookie Policy
markdown:
# Cookie Policy

_Version 1.0.0 · Last updated 2026-10-02_

This policy explains how Calecute Technologies LLC uses cookies and similar technologies (such as browser local storage) on the I Want USA websites: https://{{USA_WEB_DOMAIN}} (including the legal, request and seller pages), the seller dashboard at https://{{USA_SELLER_DASHBOARD_DOMAIN}} and our admin panel. The mobile app does not use browser cookies; see the [Privacy Policy](/legal/privacy-policy) for what the app collects.

## 1. Cookies we use

| Name or type | Category | Purpose | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sb-<project>-auth-token` (local storage or cookie) | Strictly necessary | Keeps you signed in to the seller dashboard and admin panel (Supabase Auth session) | Until you sign out; refresh token up to 30 days |
| `iwant_consent` | Strictly necessary | Remembers your cookie choices | 12 months |
| `iwant_locale` | Functional | Remembers your language | 12 months |
| Cloudflare Turnstile | Strictly necessary | Bot protection on sign-up, waitlist, contact and report forms | Session |
| `__stripe_mid`, `__stripe_sid` or Razorpay checkout cookies (only on payment pages) | Strictly necessary | Fraud prevention during seller plan checkout by our payment provider (Stripe) | Up to 1 year / 30 minutes |
| `_vercel_*` (preview deployments only) | Strictly necessary | Access protection for preview sites, not used on the live site | Session |
| Vercel Web Analytics | Analytics (cookieless) | Counts page views in aggregate without cookies or cross-site identifiers | Not stored on your device |

We **do not** use advertising cookies, cross-site tracking pixels or social media tracking cookies, and we do not allow third parties to place advertising cookies on our sites.

## 2. Your choices

Strictly necessary cookies are needed for sign-in, security and payments and cannot be switched off in our cookie settings, but you can block them in your browser (some features will then stop working). Functional cookies can be turned off in **Cookie settings** in the site footer. You can also set your browser to send the Global Privacy Control (GPC) signal; we treat it as an opt-out of sale and sharing (we do not sell or share personal information in any case).

## 3. Changes and contact

We update this policy when we change the cookies we use. Questions: {{PRIVACY_EMAIL}} · Calecute Technologies LLC, {{US_BUSINESS_ADDRESS}}
